notes.title: Taimumari five-year anniversary and update to Definitive Edition
notes.notes:
https://cdn.cloudflare.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25363761/02592ac56fab21f3686b5c2c9deb0925525258ea.jpg
On December 16, 2015 I released my first commercial game - Taimumari. It was not a perfect and polished game, but it was my dream. With Taimumari I was able to leave my office work and realize my projects.

And today, five years later, the game gets a major upgrade, straight from the consoles. I hope you will be pleased with the new graphics in the dialogues. If you wish, you can also play the classic version. https://store.steampowered.com/app/375520
The new Definitive Edition also includes an addition with Kanashimi, which now does not need to be purchased separately.

I am also developing Taimumari 2 and unfortunately I was not able to release it by the fifth anniversary as planned. There's still a lot of work to do, so I don't know when I can release it yet. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1292400
However, my small BakuMari project will be released soon - you can check out its Steam page now. https://store.steampowered.com/app/1470880/BakuMari
I appreciate your support and hope that you will also play my future games. Thank you all!

notes.title: IN-VERT: Definitive Edition update
notes.notes:
All IN-VERT owners get the new version of Definitive Edition right from the consoles. What did the game get?

Comic Stripes Now you can learn the story of the main character in more detail. He's looking for his owner - Explosion Girl, which you can know from the game Taimumari.

A new 5th world It required a new world to complete the story - that's 14 new levels and a special final boss.

The new interface The new improved interface will make the game more comfortable and attractive.

The old version of the game also remains available for fans of classics.

notes.title: Taimumari: Kanashimi mode and update 1.3
Patch 1.0.2. Online Speedruners Leaderboards!
notes.notes:
Hi! It's new update for IN-VERT, and now game has online leaderboard for every world.
For game in speedrun mode, you must start world on first level and pass all levels to the boss without shutting down the game.
